GET TO KNOW VALERIAN

A practical perspective.
A meaningful purpose.

Valerian’s veterinary portfolio brings together injectable presentations across anti-infective, parasite and supportive care. Our focus is the everyday reality of animal health: the herd, the farm, the stable and the professionals who look after them.

Every animal and every setting has its own needs. We connect clear product overviews with practical care resources, so a first visit can become a more informed conversation with the right veterinary professional.

OUR PURPOSE

To support thoughtful veterinary care for the animals that work beside us and sustain our communities.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Your questions,
answered.

A starting point for understanding the portfolio and making a useful product enquiry.

What does Valerian focus on?

Valerian focuses on veterinary products for farm and large animals. The current portfolio shown here comprises six injectable presentations across anti-infective, parasite and supportive care.

Is every product suitable for every animal?

No. Suitability depends on the individual product, approved species, local registration and the animal's needs. Request the official product leaflet and consult the treating veterinarian.

How can I request more product information?

Open a product and choose “Enquire about this product”. The product name will be selected automatically. Include your organisation and the information you need, such as the official leaflet or local availability.

Can I buy products on this website?

This website is a product information and enquiry destination. It does not offer online checkout. Product availability and commercial arrangements can be discussed with the official regional representative listed in the footer.

Where can I find dosage or administration instructions?

Use the official product leaflet and the instructions given by your veterinarian. Website summaries do not replace the complete prescribing information or professional advice.
